input.config_yaml:
# Same shape as LlamaFactory v0.9.5 examples/train_qlora/qwen3_lora_sft_otfq.yaml.
# Send it as input.config_yaml (string) or host it and send input.config_url.
# output_dir / dataset_dir / cache_dir / report_to are set by the worker.
### model
model_name_or_path: Qwen/Qwen3-4B-Instruct-2507
quantization_bit: 4
quantization_method: bnb

### method
stage: sft
finetuning_type: lora
lora_rank: 8
lora_target: all

### dataset
dataset: tiny_sft
template: qwen3_nothink
cutoff_len: 2048

### output
logging_steps: 10
save_steps: 500
plot_loss: true

### train
per_device_train_batch_size: 1
gradient_accumulation_steps: 8
learning_rate: 1.0e-4
num_train_epochs: 3.0
lr_scheduler_type: cosine
warmup_ratio: 0.1
bf16: true
